brief: Client: type 4 ground floor; same system + design as the basement but no dark ceilings everywhere; design after refs 19-22; golden hour light from the windows; double height over the living room only; easy plan-accurate angles; photoreal.
lessons: the model invents furniture from mood refs (an ottoman at the bed foot) -> say 'no bench / ottoman' explicitly
structure retries go text + mood refs only; a previous render as reference carries its geometry
consistency: KIT_A/KIT_B/HALL_A vs LIV_A PASS; LIV_B vs LIV_A cognac cushions dC 20.5 and BED_B vs BED_A floor/throw dL 32-35 - sun-lit vs shaded, same materials on vision -> accepted

LIV_B.note: glass corner, attempt 5: structure 0.956, drift 0.002 - gate PASS

revision_2.client: living ceiling read as angled - walls must meet it at 90 deg; paintings on the fluted walnut wall; ensuite 70 % dark with nice ambient light, the light marble only as details
revision_2.diagnosis: old LIV_A: the model drew a sloped ceiling (ceiling recall 0); old LIV_B: correct geometry but the wide two-point view without a visible corner reads as a pitched plane
revision_2.fix: living re-shot as a one-point frontal view (ceiling line horizontal) + a glass-corner view (ceiling corner visible); cove line at the ceiling removed; triptych 3 x 100 x 150 cm over the sofa; ensuite: Nero Marquina walls, dark floor + ceiling with perimeter cove, warm cream marble only on the shower back wall and vanity top
rejected: LIV_A #4 (kitchen ceiling + void wall turned into a slope)
revision_2.consistency: KIT_B PASS; LIV_B frames dL 78 (backlit by the sky), KIT_A bronze mesh dC 18 (glow), HALL_A marble sliver - light, not material -> accepted on vision

revision_3.reason: the first-floor plan shows the floor above is open over the whole stair and the entrance (double height) - the ground model had a ceiling there
revision_3.fix: hall ceiling opened up to the first-floor ceiling (5.9 m), gallery slab edges + UOG.2/UOG.3, tall glazing over the front door, monumental painting, 3 globe pendants; KIT_A re-aimed so the void does not read as a sloped ceiling
rejected: KIT_A #3 (0.851 but the void read as a sloped ceiling)
